title: Copilot Studio: web browsing for agents on the Microsoft Copilot harness
summary: Hold: the credit-allocation API request omits the required allocatedEntitlements array, so an administrator cannot use its body as printed. The roadmap facts, billing explanation and documented UI paths are supported; the briefing appropriately distinguishes the planned browsing capability from the existing standard-harness computer use tool.

claims.claim: PUT https://api.powerplatform.com/licensing/allocationsV2?api-version=2024-10-01 accepts the printed body with scope.environmentId, entitlementId, allocation.quantity and enforcementRules at the shown levels.
claims.fix: Replace the call in controls[0].api and its rendered table cell with: PUT https://api.powerplatform.com/licensing/allocationsV2?api-version=2024-10-01; headers: Authorization: Bearer <token>, Content-Type: application/json; body: {"scope":{"environmentId":"<id>"},"allocatedEntitlements":[{"entitlementId":"MCSMessages","allocation":{"quantity":<n>},"enforcementRules":[{"ruleType":"TenantPool","enabled":false}]}]}. The endpoint and API version are documented; the missing allocatedEntitlements array is required to nest the entitlement, allocation and enforcement rules as shown in the cited tutorial.
